files.description: Streaming subscribers, one per row (320 rows): subscriber_id (whole number), age (years, from 19 to 87; about 1% empty), tier (basic, plus or premium; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), monthly_fee (two decimals; about 3% empty), joined_year (whole number).

task_text: Set the tier (lower case, no surrounding spaces) as the index of the subscribers table, then loop over the groups of that index level to build a plain Python dictionary that maps each tier name to the total monthly fee of its subscribers, rounded to two decimals. `result` should be that dictionary.
intended_computation: Return a dict with the 3 tier names as keys and the summed monthly_fee per tier (missing fees skipped) as values.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x iterating over groups of a one-element level list yields 1-tuples, so the dictionary keys become tuples

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
